messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look calendar of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(These are the dates that either fell on a weekend or were officially observed on a Monday, giving you a three‑day break.)

| Date | Holiday | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|
| **Dec 31 – Jan 2** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the following Monday was a statutory holiday. |
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | A provincial holiday that created a long weekend in those provinces. |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | A federal holiday that gave a long weekend across the country. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Celebrated on the last Monday in May; a long weekend nationwide. |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the following Monday was a holiday. |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | A federal holiday that created a long weekend. |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | A federal holiday that gave a long weekend. |
| **Dec 25–27** | Christmas & Boxing Day | Christmas fell on Monday, so the next two days were holidays, creating a four‑day break. |

> **Pro‑Tip:** If you’re planning trips for specific provinces, remember that holidays such as Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day (New Brunswick), and others vary by region.  

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app!
message.reasoning:
The user wants the list of long weekends for Canada in 2023. They want to fetch it. We have a tool "connectBluetooth" but that's irrelevant. There's no tool to fetch holidays. We can provide the answer manually. We should respond with the list. Let's produce a list of Canadian public holidays that create long weekends in 2023. In Canada, long weekends typically include New Year's Day (Jan 1), Family Day (Feb 20 in some provinces), Good Friday (April 7), Victoria Day (May 22), Canada Day (July 1), Labour Day (Sep 4), Thanksgiving (Oct 9), Remembrance Day (Nov 11), Christmas (Dec 25). But not all are long weekends. For example, New Year's Day falls on Sunday, so Jan 2 is observed. That creates a long weekend from Dec 31 to Jan 2. Family Day is Feb 20 (Monday) - long weekend. Good Friday is April 7 (Friday) - long weekend. Victoria Day is May 22 (Monday) - long weekend. Canada Day is July 1 (Saturday) - observed July 3 (Monday) - long weekend. Labour Day is Sep 4 (Monday) - long weekend. Thanksgiving is Oct 9 (Monday) - long weekend. Remembrance Day is Nov 11 (Wednesday) - not long weekend. Christmas is Dec 25 (Monday) - long weekend. Also Boxing Day is Dec 26 (Tuesday) - not long weekend.

We should mention that some holidays are province-specific. But the user didn't specify province. So we can give national holidays that create long weekends. Provide a table.
